info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Market Making API allows clients to update market-making parameters for wholesale trading based on the provided identifier. This endpoint facilitates changes to specific market parameters, enabling agile responses to market conditions. Typical consumers include trading firms and financial institutions that require real-time adjustments to their trading strategies. By utilizing this API, users can optimize their trading performance and maintain competitive advantage in the fast-paced wholesale trading environment.
